title: KNOW WHICH WAY IS UP
goal: Restore a usable orientation signal and make the humanoid stand for 30 seconds.

phases.name: HOOK
phases.goal: Observe the failure before attempting a fix.

phases.name: DISCOVER
phases.goal: Tilt the robot and observe what the IMU actually measures.

phases.name: MANIPULATE
phases.goal: Disable and restore the IMU to isolate its effect.

phases.name: CONNECT
phases.goal: Repair the information path from IMU to State Estimation.

phases.name: CAUSE / EFFECT
phases.goal: Reduce stale sensor timing and watch estimate confidence recover.

phases.name: GUIDED TEST
phases.goal: Pass the standing test with a coherent sensing-to-control chain.

phases.name: TRANSFER
phases.goal: Diagnose a different failure without blaming the IMU automatically.

phases.name: COMPLETE
phases.goal: Lock the orientation stack into the persistent robot.

disclaimer: All values are fictional training values and do not represent real Dyno specifications.
